basic_details.job_title: IIT Dharwad Project Associate 1 Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil and Infrastructure Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad (IIT Dharwad) is filling one temporary Project Associate-1 position on the project "Comprehensive Stability and Feasibility Analysis for the Stacking of Dry Zinc Mine Tailings at Rajpura Dariba Mines". Pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month + 20% HRA for an initial 6 months. The essential qualification is a Graduate Degree in Civil Engineering with GATE qualification, or a Post Graduate Degree in Geotechnical Engineering/other relevant specializations of Civil Engineering with First Class in both UG & P

content_sections.heading: About IIT Dharwad
content_sections.text: IIT Dharwad is an Institute of National Importance created by an Act of Parliament in 2016, located at Chikkamalligawad, Dharwad, Karnataka. The Institute needs the Project Associate-1 for a project in its Department of Civil and Infrastructure Engineering, and the position is described as temporary.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists one position of Project Associate-1. The number of vacancies is tentative, and IIT Dharwad reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of advertised posts at the time of selection, or not to fill the post at all. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate Degree in Civil Engineering with GATE qualification; or Post Graduate Degree in Geotechnical Engineering/other relevant specializations of Civil Engineering with First Class in both UG & PG. The qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute. Experience in geotechnical testing, slope stability analysis, numerical modeling (e.g., GeoStudio, FLAC, PLAXIS), and technical report writing. Not exceeding 35 years as on the date of selection process. Eligibility in terms of age, qualification and experience is considered as on the date of the Selection Process. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated emoluments are Rs. 37,000/- per month + 20% HRA. The appointment is initially for 6 months and is extendable to another six months based on performance. Selected candidates have no claim on any regular position and are not given privileges such as Housing, Medical Facility and other benefits available to regular employees of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Project Associate-1 Job Description
content_sections.text: Research related to geotechnical engineering and slope stability. Perform geotechnical stability and seepage analyses. Geotechnical Laboratory experiments and characterization. The candidate has to work in collaboration with the research scholars in the group.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Dharwad Project Associate-1
content_sections.text: Candidates apply through the Google Forms link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/Uu5dX9HgjA34JZ3V9 , on or before 6 December 2026. The notice does not describe the form-filling steps. Online version of all original certificates including mark sheets (matriculation onwards) Experience certificate(s) Monthly emoluments/salary drawn Other relevant documents, including one set of self-attested certificate(s)/document(s) Updated Curriculum Vitae For queries about the selection process, applicants may write to [email protected] . Queries on eligibility for the post or interpretation of rules will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened first. Only shortlisted applicants are called for an interview in online mode, and emails are sent to all shortlisted candidates. Mere fulfilment of minimum eligibility does not give the right to shortlisting, and IIT Dharwad reserves the right to screen and shortlist candidates by introducing higher benchmarks. No TA/DA is paid for attending the Selection Process.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Any change in the schedule will be notified on the IIT Dharwad website.
